hero.title: Technical integrator with a frontend background
hero.lead: I build offers, set up trackers and postbacks, and get up to speed with new tools quickly.

workflow.title: From offer to postback
workflow.intro: What I take on in a funnel, and where it has come up in my work.

steps.title: Offer
steps.text: I build the offer page myself or with AI tools. One React codebase can switch its logic and scripts by UTM parameters, so a single app serves several offers.

steps.title: Tracker
steps.text: I connect the offer to Keitaro, Binom or AiO: campaigns, offers, traffic distribution, custom macros and S2S postbacks between tracker, network and ad platform.

steps.title: Lead delivery
steps.text: The lead goes where it is needed: Meta Pixel and Conversions API with event_id deduplication, Google Ads conversions, or a CRM with custom business logic.

steps.title: Debugging
steps.text: When numbers don't match, I trace the chain step by step: browser DevTools, tracker logs, postback responses, and geo or cloaking checks in Octo Browser with proxies.

steps.title: Learning new tools
steps.text: I get a new tool working from its docs. When AiO had no public API for routine tasks, I studied its internal API in DevTools and scripted bulk white-page uploads and traffic rules.
